title: Can't remember my dreams
content: So every since I found this forum and started talking to more people about mallworld, I've stopped being able to remember my dreams and I usually can about 95% of the time. I wake up having of vague recollection that I was in the mall or other various places but I try to remember anything about it and I can't. I feel like ive been banned lol. It's probably just coincidence but has anyone experienced this?
